profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
I am a developer and a functional designer who value the importance of great user experience. I find motivation in building products to help enhance my users' life, make their jobs easier, more efficient or even better, enable them to do what they could not do before.

To achieve a high level of user satisfaction, I engage the end users throughout the development cycle. I observe the way they work, listen to the problems they face and more importantly find out the 'why' behind every request.

Outside works, I'm constantly looking for ways to automate my life or make it better using both web and mobile technologies.

projects.title: Nestaurant POS App
projects.description:
Nestaurant is a clean and easy to use Point of Sales system built for the iPad. It is primarily targeted at restaurants at different sizes. Business owner or staff can quickly create eat-in or takeaway orders and have an overview of what's currently happening in their restaurant. Receipts can be printed directly from the app to most popular Thermal printers in a professional & customisable template including the ability for restaurant owner to specify their business details on the printout.

App Store link: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/nestaurant/id899367323?mt=8

projects.title: WellSpend App
projects.description:
WellSpend is a budget app released on the iOS platform that helps users keep track of their spendings and over time learn about their spending/saving habit. This is the first app that I released as a result of learning iOS in my personal time while working as a software engineer at RedBalloon.

Website: http://wellspendapp.com/
